messages:
maria: T-minus 30 for the EU 23:00 change window. Quick rollcall — confirm pins, rollback owners, release notes link.

deploy-bot: Automated preflight check: services health OK. Pin status snapshot: api-service=unpinned, embed-worker=pinned v4.1.2, web-frontend=pinned v5.0.0-rc. Run `/deploy pin <service> <version>` to pin.

kevin: I just pinned api-service to v3.2.1 — includes the timeout/backoff patch. @deploy-bot please confirm.

deploy-bot: Command received: `/deploy pin api-service v3.2.1` — pin successful. Audit id: 2026-03-21-119.

ops_sam: I'll own rollback for api-service. My trigger criteria: SLO drop >3% OR p95 latency +500ms sustained >5m OR 5xx spike > 10/min for 3m. If triggered I will unpin and run the revert playbook.

jules: Canary plan: route 5% of EU traffic for 15m. Abort conditions: any 5xxs above baseline or any endpoint with >200ms p95 increase. We'll monitor error tagging in traces.

sre-anna: FYI console alerting runbook updated; pager goes to oncall if 5xxs > 10/min for 3 consecutive minutes. I've pasted the runbook in #eng-oncall earlier.

maria: Release notes are here: https://docs.internal/releases/2026-03-eu-refresh — includes notes on embeddings behavior and config flags. Everyone ack the notes and call out anything missing.

kevin: Ack. Also adding a smoke test: `curl -H 'x-env: eu' https://api.internal/health` — returns 200 + version header.

ops_sam: Ack. Revert PR ready: https://git.internal/repo/reverts/PR-842. I'll stand by in #rollback-channel.

deploy-bot: Reminder: deploy window starts in 10m. Automated canary rollout will apply after pin confirmation. Auto-unpin on manual abort after 2m.

maria: :thumbsup: Final check — database migrations included? safe?

kevin: Confirmed: no DB migrations, feature flag default=off, no schema changes.

jules: One ask — embeddings cost cap for canary is set to $2000/day. ops_sam please watch the billing alerts during the window.

ops_sam: Setting the billing alert threshold now and will monitor the cost dashboard.

maria: OK team — go/no-go in 5. If no objections in this thread assume go. Silence = go. :rocket:

(END THREAD)
